findings.title: Large-divisor threshold does not imply an affine scheme
findings.location: PDF p.28 Definition 5.1.7.1 eq.(5.1.1), Lemma 5.1.7.2; source coeffs.tex 3126-3148
findings.source_claim: For all positive roots pairing(degD,alpha)>g-1 implies Bun_N^{Omega(-D)} affine scheme
findings.complete_check: C, G=PGL2, smooth completion y^2=x^5-x, g=2, infinity P, div(dx/y)=2P, theta=O(P), D=2rho^vee P. Pairing=2>1, but root line Omega(-2P)=O and torsor stack is A^2 x BGa. Nontrivial Ga stabilizer contradicts scheme representability.
findings.counterevidence: Fixed T-bundle fiber is a torsor stack, not its coarse space. Definition uses 2rho^vee on theta. Later proof may choose arbitrarily large D.
findings.impact: Lemma false at allowed boundary; its use in Step1 must be restricted. Strengthening simple-root bound to >2g-2 restores affineness; arbitrary-large choice in Step2 preserves the later exactness deduction conditional on other inputs.
findings.repair_verification: Analytic: all positive-root line degrees become negative; H0=H2=0, central root-height filtration gives successive affine vector torsors. Rank-one example checked explicitly.
findings.known_issue_status: No correction of this numerical claim identified in consulted passages; no exhaustive novelty claim.

independent_acceptance.reasoning: P1: the genus-two PGL2 example satisfies every stated positive-root bound (2>g-1) but the root line is O_X, so the additive torsor has a nontrivial Ga stabilizer and is not a scheme. The stronger simple-root bound >2g-2 kills H0; H2 vanishes on the curve and the root-height central filtration gives successive affine vector torsors. Step 2 expressly permits arbitrarily large divisors, so the actual later use supports Minor. H1: for SL2 on the elliptic curve y^2=x^3-x with lambda=0, four two-torsion kernel lines give four nonempty open-closed components in the alleged connected stratum. The mu2 x Ga centralizer confirms the count. Degree-only selection of the whole stratum is used for canonical-point membership and then conservativity. Hence the pinned-v1 highest supported impact is Major, known_issue_reproduced, even though later author passages correct component handling with central torsors and translations. No main-theorem counterexample, novel defect in the later manuscript, journal equivalence, or complete later-proof certification is claimed.
